verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is an identity-verification product, so business verification (KYB) is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only documents verifying individuals: government ID checks, selfie matching, SSN and ID-number validation. Nothing in the pack shows business registry lookups, UBO identification, or KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners
